items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: No, I never knew him. But the last time I saw Paul Robeson was when he was at 116th Street in the Square, and Duke had the band there. And he happened to come by.

ctx.x: Paul Robeson to me was a great -- he's still great. He went to White Russia, Georgia*, and he married a woman over there, I think. Yeah, he married a white woman.
